sloka: तम् समीक्ष्य तु अवहितम् पितुर् निर्देश पालने ।कौसल्या बाष्प सम्रुद्धा वचो धर्मिष्ठम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२४-१॥
transliteration: tam samīkṣya tu avahitam pitur nirdeśa pālane ।kausalyā bāṣpa samruddhā vaco dharmiṣṭham abravīt ॥2-24-1॥

translations.english: Having perceived that Rama was determined to carry out his father's command, Kausalya with her throat choked with tears said these words of piety:
